background: OCBC is Singapore's second-largest bank, funded by Singapore dollar deposits and lending across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Greater China, with Great Eastern as its insurance arm and Bank of Singapore in private banking.
synthesis: The bank is rated AA on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at AA-, all three on a stable outlook. Capital is strong against Asian banks, with CET1 of 15.7% above the peer median and leverage of 6.5% in the top quarter, though they have fallen 1.3 points and 0.8 points since 30 Jun 2025. Liquidity is on the weak side, with LCR of 131% and NSFR of 109% both in the bottom quarter. The newest flagged item, on 18 Sep 2026, is higher half-year profit at its Macau arm, and the rest are record group profit and research notes, none a credit concern.
